Set the display color for one label id on a Napari Labels layer.

Updates the color backup used by apply_label_visibility() so custom colors survive show/hide toggles in the label picker.

nvitk.gui.labels.visibility.ensure_labels_layer(viewer: Any, layer: Any) → Any¶

Return a Napari Labels layer for layer, converting Image masks in place.

Discrete segmentation Image layers (e.g. QC seg_4dflow) cannot use per-label colors; this replaces them with an equivalent Labels layer at the same stack index so color editing works.
